Theo: Quick life update — I put a ring on it last night :heart_eyes: and were also expecting a tiny human in November. Sorry for the double drop but we wanted to share the joy. Thinking a small office meetup (potluck?) Friday at 1pm. 

Lina: OMG congrats!!! :tada: So much love. Friday works for me. Potluck yes pls.

Marco: Double congrats, Theo!! Count me in. I can bring empanadas or something savory.

Jen: This is the best news!! :confetti_ball: I can handle dessert — cupcakes? Also can we do a tiny banner?

Omar: Huge congrats :raised_hands: Ill DJ and bring sparkling cider. Potluck poll: Reply with emoji for what youd bring

Kit: 361 sushi tray (makes sharing easy)

Lina: 35f pasta salad

Marco: 9c2 empanadas (I got this)

Jen: 382 cupcakes + mini cake for the photo

Theo: Love it. Also quick callout: if anyone wants to add 1 line to a card for us, drop it here and well print. No long speeches pls :grin:

Omar: "Theo  Huge congrats on both—so excited for your next chapter. Team is celebrating with you!"

Lina: "So happy for you both. Sending all the good vibes and diapers. :)"

Kit: "Congrats! If you need baby name vetoes, I volunteer as judge. :)"

HR Bot: Event created: https://calendar.company.internal/e/1807654321-theo-potluck (Fri Oct 8  1:00pm Community Room) :calendar: Please RSVP.

Theo: Thanks everyone. Also, practical q  who can help hang a 5-minute banner at 12:45? Marco? Jen?

Marco: I can do 12:30 setup. Jen can you bring tape?

Jen: Tape and scissors = I got you. Also bringing a spare bib for the baby picture.
